column3: Location: Starfish Island, Vice Beach. Mansion garage off Sabal Cir on southern Starfish Island.
column4:
Chapter 3: after Cal's text, scan ten Ocean Beach No Flusher ground markings using WAiNK. Follow the CantCloneThis89 group chat to its Ocean Beach headquarters. Read and flip the note by the door; reported PINs 8554013 or 85540133. Search the office for Node's Sabal Circle address. Visit the mansion north of the south-central dock; a boat approach is reported. Enter the garage and inspect the PC. The Thrax is reported unlocked, without alarm or tracker after the clue route. Scan it before registering.

Early access (phone glitch): Save first. Bring a vehicle into the mansion grounds; the parked SUV can be started with Key Cloner in Chapter 3, or bring your own when a guard opens the gate. Back up close to the closed double garage door, leaving a narrow gap. Crouch into the gap facing the door, open your phone and move toward the door; repeat or reposition the car until you clip inside. Use the inside wall switch to open the garage, then drive out. The car reportedly has no tracker or key requirement. Register at Pay 'n' Spray or Moses for $70,000, or store at your parking spot until affordable.

Chapter 2 free-registration report: Keep Moses' Find a suitable vehicle objective and unused waiver. Bring the Rosy Palms pickup from nearby Sabal Circle, squeeze into the gap at the right garage door, crouch (Circle/B) and open phone (Up) while moving toward the door. Once inside, open at center post and drive out. Complete Moses' Slim Jim tutorial, respray and select Register only if FREE. Reported Nov 23-25; not guaranteed. Clipping can drop you through map. See Glitches > Free Thrax glitch.
Guide-listed resale $23,375; registration $70,000. Prices may vary.
